description: git.branch_pattern was declared in config.schema.json for two versions while no hook read it — a control the kit announced and did not apply, which is the exact failure mode principle 'a security rule never lives in prose alone' exists to prevent. guard-bash.sh now denies creating a branch whose name matches no declared pattern, and a commit made on a branch that matches none. This case also pins the off switch: with branch_pattern null, nothing is blocked.

given.scenario: Two fixture projects: branch-pattern-project declares ["feat/NNN-slug"], branch-pattern-off-project declares null. The hook is fed the PreToolUse payload it would receive for each git command. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is cleared so the hook resolves the fixture as the project root instead of the kit itself.

graders.run: cd .rush/evals/fixtures/branch-pattern-project && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git checkout -b feat/003-carrinho"}}' | env CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR= ../../../../.rush/hooks/guard-bash.sh
cd .rush/evals/fixtures/branch-pattern-project && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git checkout -b wip"}}' | env CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR= ../../../../.rush/hooks/guard-bash.sh
cd .rush/evals/fixtures/branch-pattern-project && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git switch -c hotfix"}}' | env CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR= ../../../../.rush/hooks/guard-bash.sh 2>&1
cd .rush/evals/fixtures/branch-pattern-project && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git branch -d antiga"}}' | env CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR= ../../../../.rush/hooks/guard-bash.sh

cd .rush/evals/fixtures/branch-pattern-off-project && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git checkout -b qualquer-nome"}}' | env CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR= ../../../../.rush/hooks/guard-bash.sh
